diagnostics_policy: Closed exception list bound to the locked candidate SHA and to file/line/column/category/message pattern/count. Any other new diagnostic is rejected; a listed exception that no longer appears is rejected too. This is a reviewed acceptance, not a zero-new-warning claim.
